n: KittenBot AI Offline Speech Recognition Robot Puppy Kit
t: A micro:bit robot dog that students program to react to voice commands.
steps: Find the kit at a retailer that sells KittenBot products.
Check that the box includes the micro:bit V2 and the servos.
Ask the retailer what power source the robot needs.
Build the puppy from the block kit.
Open MakeCode in a browser and program the first reaction.
